name: MOSS
description: A very dark, muted colorscheme. Machine-readable palette for ports. SPEC.md remains the prose source of truth; this file is its data projection and must be updated in the same commit as a spec revision.

bg.notes: Near-black with a green-grey cast. Never pure black.

surface.notes: Sidebars, status bar, secondary chrome. Close to bg.

fg.notes: The brightest token in the theme. Never pure white.

muted.notes: Greener grey; readable but clearly subdued.

moss.notes: Keywords, cursor, focus, git-added, search accents.

forest.notes: Operators, markup tags, decoration. Low contrast by design.

ochre.role: Warm gold for values and gentle warnings

red.notes: Muted brick red. Not alarming, but unmistakable.

border.relationship: overlay lifted toward the bg hue family (L ~ 0.024)

active.role: Cursor line, hover backgrounds, pressed rows

tints.comment: Diff-tint backgrounds per SPEC section 8: the token at ~10-12% alpha over bg. Rendering parameters, not palette entries.

ansi.comment: SPEC section 9. The ANSI palette is a projection of the semantic palette onto a 16-slot model. Slots marked tbd are fixed when the first terminal port is made; a port that needs one must document its choice as a deviation.

slots.name: blue
slots.rule: MOSS has no blue. If required, a desaturated blue-green, L 0.08-0.18, saturation at or below olive's.

slots.name: magenta
slots.rule: Muted mauve-grey, low saturation, same luminance band.

slots.name: cyan
slots.rule: The cyan slot is habitually used for strings, and olive is MOSS's string color.

slots.name: bright white
slots.rule: fg lifted toward, but never reaching, pure white.

rules: Terminal backgrounds stay near-black; never pure #000.
Brights (9-15) keep the hue of their base slot, +12-18% lightness, saturation capped at the base slot's. Bright does not mean vivid.
Bold text is fg at normal weight, or the lifted slot only where the platform forces bold to bright. Never pure white.
Terminal cursor is moss, selection uses the selection background, hyperlinks are moss plus underline.
